newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pasminco plans equity raising for Century.
newsitem.headline: Pasminco plans equity raising for Century.

text.p: Mining house Pasminco Ltd said on Friday it has appointed stockbrokers J B Were & Son and SBC Warburg Australia Ltd as joint underwriters for a planned equity raising to partly fund the acquisition of the Century zinc mine in Queensland.

In January, Pasminco said it would buy the Century mine and the nearby Dugald River zinc projects from RTZ-CRA for A$345 million conditional on the Queensland state government issuing mining leases which depend on and Aborginal groups resolving the current impasse.
Funds from the raising would be used both for acquisition and development requirements, Trevor Shard, Pasminco's company secretary said.
He said the actual amount of funding sought from the equity raising was not yet determined
"I won't be drawn on a figure. We haven't decided,"
However, Pasminco would aim to keep debt to equity at a maximum 40 percent, Shard said.
